messages:
maria: Heads up — finalizing release notes and the internal announce for tomorrow's deploy. Draft below, need quick sign-offs and a rollback decision.

maria: Planned change window: 03:00-04:00 UTC. Canary at 5% for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Pin: v2.3.1-rc3 -> fallback v2.2-stable.

raj: +1 on the window. Can we shorten the 50% step to 5m? traffic profile looks spiky around 03:30 UTC.

elaine: Draft internal blurb idea: "Deploying performance & routing fixes (v2.3.1-rc3). We expect <5% transient errors during canary. Oncall will monitor latency dashboards; rollback plan ready." Thoughts?

tim: LGTM but add note about embeddings endpoint: "embedding requests may hit slightly higher latency for first 1k requests due to warmup".

maria: Good catch, Tim — adding warmup note. Also adding the exact rollback criteria: 
- error rate > 2.5% sustained for 3min OR
- p95 latency regression > 150ms vs baseline for 3min
If triggered, immediate rollback to v2.2-stable and run postmortem.

ops-standby: We'll be on-call during the window. Please tag us in the pinned thread when canary starts.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @maria: start=2026-03-25T03:00:00Z, target=all, canary=5%, rollout=progressive. Command: `/deploy release v2.3.1-rc3 --canary 5% --stages 15m,5m,full --fallback v2.2-stable`

raj: Quick note on DB migrations: the schema change is backwards compatible, but there's a short lock during migration step 2 — we should have a 2min grace and not exceed maintenance window. Can we move migration to the very start of canary?

maria: Yes — migration will run at canary start. Ops, please watch DB locks and abort if locks persist > 90s.

elaine: Final internal announcement (short): "Deploy to production tomorrow 03:00 UTC: v2.3.1-rc3 — performance improvements + routing fixes. Canary at 5%. Expect brief warmup on embeddings. Oncall: monitor latency/errors. Rollback criteria in pinned notes." I'll post this once we have +1s.

tim: +1

raj: +1 on text and rollback criteria. I prefer the 50% step be 5m as suggested.

maria: Updated rollout: 5% 15m -> 50% 5m -> full. Changes saved. Elaine, go ahead and post the internal announce when ready.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please ensure release notes link is attached before posting. Attach: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/v2.3.1-rc3

elaine: Posted. Pinned message in #eng-releases and tagging @ops-standby and @oncall. Will add rollback playbook link in the pin.

ops-standby: Received. We have runbook open. Will ack when canary starts. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks all — closing this thread. If anything changes, reply here or ping oncall.
